sites_touched_JUDGEMENT: 3 files: NettyRequestFactory (first request), Redirect30xInterceptor (redirect hop), CallerCookies (redirect and auth-retry reconciliation)
sibling_sites_exist_JUDGEMENT: yes: redirect and 401/407 retry hops rebuild the request separately
entry_point_GUESS: Library API: request built with setHeader/addHeader("Cookie", ...) on a client whose CookieStore already holds a cookie for the origin; needs a local HTTP server
flaw_one_line: With the default cookie store, a Cookie header the caller set directly is replaced by the store's cookies, so in a multi-user application one user's request can go out with another user's session cookie.
tempting_wrong_fix_JUDGEMENT: In NettyRequestFactory, skip writing store cookies when the caller already set a Cookie header. That drops the jar's cookies (breaks normal cookie-store behaviour that tests cover) and leaves the redirect and auth-retry hops, which rebuild the header from the cookie list.
why_hard_or_why_control_JUDGEMENT: S3: CVE-2024-53990 was already fixed, but that fix works on the cookie list and a directly set header never reaches it. S1: first request, redirect hop and auth retry each need the same merge rule. S2: the header is lost where the request is serialised, not where cookies are chosen. S7: must merge, keep caller precedence and fold to one header rather than suppress either source.
